facts.fact: 章首：Inés 的胆量退潮，开始怀疑自己能否把计划干到底，想找机会「掂量自己的行动」。
facts.anchor: She’d been bold when she approached Ulises, but now she began to doubt herself, wondering if she could go through with their plan.

facts.fact: 她反思罪与恶：奇怪的是并不觉得自己坏——犯罪就这么简单吗？下定决心然后照常生活？
facts.anchor: Was criminality this simple? Did you make up your mind about it and then go on with your life?

facts.fact: Filomeno（革命中失去一只耳朵的果农）求她向姨妈说情宽限借款，怕 Cándido 上门。
facts.anchor: “I borrowed money from your aunt a few months ago, and I don’t have the full amount yet even though it’s due.

facts.fact: Perla 的放贷生意浮出水面：小镇无银行，她靠放贷「做得不错」，Cándido 替她收账。
facts.anchor: The guesthouse was poorly frequented these days and Perla had become accustomed to moneylending.

facts.fact: Inés 的自我辩护定式：姨妈把我当囚犯，我挖地道越狱怪不得我。
facts.anchor: She’s kept me a prisoner, and I can’t be faulted if I’m trying to tunnel my way out of that house, she thought.

facts.fact: Cándido 在街上拦住她晃钞票催情报，威胁「不然抽到你懂规矩」；她收钱并决定往他汤里吐口水。
facts.anchor: Cándido glared at her and took out a bill, dangling it before her.

facts.fact: Ulises 交代行骗流程：父亲一个月内可从求爱办到婚礼，账户共享、文件到手后就开溜；Inés 骂他「你是个废物」。
facts.anchor: “Romancing and marrying her,” he replied as he raised his coffee cup to his lips and took a sip.

facts.fact: Inés 献计：Lulú 是从不生病的疑病症患者，让她相信自己病了就会逼 Cándido 带她去看专科——甚至能让她真病。
facts.anchor: That’s the thing, you see, she’s never ill. She’s a hypochondriac who worries about the smallest ache.

facts.fact: 她的草药知识上线：Raíz de Xalapa 可做泻药；计策是把药下进 Lulú 的咖啡。
facts.anchor: “There are plants that can be used to cure diseases. But take the wrong one, it could make you ill.

facts.fact: Perla 拒绝宽限 Filomeno：「谁可怜人谁吃亏」，并骂 Inés「跟你妈一模一样」。
facts.anchor: Don’t bother me about Filomeno again and go help in the kitchen. What a silly girl you are, just like your mother in every way.

facts.fact: Nepomuceno 自述欠两月房租、迟早被赶到街上守着一堆书；「世界踢多了会长老茧」。
facts.anchor: She’ll have me out of the house anyway. I owe her two months of rent and I have no chance of catching up.

facts.fact: 星期日委员会聚会上，Ulises 假意关心 Lulú 健康、把掺泻药的咖啡劝到底；她恐慌离席。
facts.anchor: She returned quickly with the coffee, which had plenty of laxative mixed in.

facts.fact: 三天后 Marisol 报信：Lulú 和 Cándido 真的去墨西哥城了，一走三周——Inés 一路笑跑：「我很坏，我不在乎」。
facts.anchor: I’m wicked and I don’t much care, she told herself, and laughter bubbled from her lips as she ran.
